lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. The clusters follow a staggered grid arrangement with higher density observed in the medial flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating visible anchor nodes, particularly in the section immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single continuous horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct elongated high-contrast silhouettes (remoras) are visible in the ventral region below the pectoral fin.
